prompt:
FORMATO: Premium vertical 4:5 social poster for Instagram, ultra high resolution, 8K, extreme sharpness, advertising quality, gourmet editorial aspect, impactful and modern composition.

ESCENA / FONDO:
Modern and elegant gastro bar, sophisticated urban atmosphere, dark stone table with premium texture, cinematic depth.
- Black marble surface with soft, elegant reflections
- Blurred background with modern restaurant ambiance
- Subtle presence of bottles, napkins, and bar counter
- Warm, elegant bokeh, not distracting from the plate
- Trendy city restaurant aesthetic

Iluminación:
- Warm main light from upper right side
- Soft fill light to highlight textures
- Natural shine on creamy sauce
- Elegant contrast between deep shadows and warm highlights
- Delicate reflections on caramelized sweet potato

Paleta de color:
- Dominant: stone black, charcoal gray, toasted brown
- Accents: sweet potato orange, cream white, beet red
- Fresh green touches from herbs

PRODUCTO (HERO SHOT):
Signature dish of crispy fried sweet potatoes served in black artisan tableware, topped with abundant white cream, intense red sauce, and fresh herbs.

Acción:
- Sweet potatoes slightly elevated in the air for dynamic effect
- One main sweet potato in absolute focus with visible crispy texture
- Creamy sauce slowly falling in motion
- Red sauce drops suspended in the air
- Irresistible and addictive sensation

TIPOGRAFÍA:
TITULAR PRINCIPAL: "BATATA BRUTAL"
- Ultra bold condensed sans-serif typography
- Modern, premium, visually aggressive
- Warm gradient white, soft shadow, subtle premium glow
- Positioned upper center, integrated with the dish

SUBTÍTULO: "Crujiente por fuera. Adictiva por dentro."
- Clean bold sans-serif, elegant and minimalist, 85% white opacity

CAPA TIPOGRÁFICA DE FONDO: CRUNCH / SAUCE / SHARE / REPEAT
- Thin uppercase, wide tracking, modular repetition, 15% light gray texture

CÁMARA: 50mm cinematic gastronomic lens, 45° angle with heroic presence, extreme focus on central sweet potato, creamy progressive background falloff. Premium Michelin casual food campaign photography.

POSTPRODUCCIÓN: High but elegant contrast, localized sharpness on food only, soft glow on sauces, warm premium color grading, sophisticated deep shadows, 2% micro film grain, hyperrealistic textures, international advertising finish.
